release_exit_criteria: open Known-Bad가 연결된 기능은 VERIFIED 금지

known_bad_lifecycle.close_rule: All required_test_ids must reach repeatability promotion_ready with no FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE and matching fresh build/vehicle evidence. CLOSED remains in regression library.
